description: Returns the full text of up to 5 consecutive pages of one agency guideline document (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA or USDA), with the document, version date, a ready-made citation and links. Useful when a passage is cut off or a table continues onto the next page.

doc_id.description: doc_id of an agency guideline document, from search results or the document list.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

end_page.description: Last page to read (inclusive). Defaults to start_page. At most 5 pages per call.
end_page.title: End Page

name: get_document_pages
title: Read agency guideline pages
